greedy.linePrev: You had a temper like my jealousy
stanza: Out on the wily, windy moors
We'd roll and fall in green
You had a temper like my jealousy
Too hot, too greedy
How could you leave me
When I needed to possess you?
I hated you, I loved you too

greedy.line: But I was greedy, I was vain
greedy.lineNext: And I forced her to working
stanza: We were poorly
Our fortunes fading hourly
And she told me her weaving
Could bring it back
But I was greedy, I was vain
And I forced her to working
And sleepily she wove me
Such perfect cloth

greedy.linePrev: Between a man named Gold and man named Mudd
greedy.line: Club filled Gold with greedy vapors
greedy.lineNext: Till his long, green eyes did glow
stanza: Club filled Gold with greedy vapors
Till his long, green eyes did glow
And Mudd was left with the sighs and trembles
Watching his hard earned money go
How do you make a magnet?
You create a potential
Just an old refrigerator magnet
Repelled and pulled
Ooohhhh why so needy?
Tell me why

needy.songTitle: I Think It’s Going to Rain Today
needy.linePrev: Bright before me, the signs implore me
needy.line: To help the needy and show them the way
stanza: Bright before me, the signs implore me
To help the needy and show them the way
Human kindness, it's overflowing
And I think it's going to rain today

needy.linePrev: Mama and Betsy say, "Find yourself a charity
needy.line: Help the needy and the crippled
needy.lineNext: Or put some time into ecology"
stanza: Dora says, "Have children"
Mama and Betsy say, "Find yourself a charity
Help the needy and the crippled
Or put some time into ecology"
Well, there's a wide wide world of noble causes
And lovely landscapes to discover
But all I really wanna do right now
Is find another lover
